about.title: Our Story
about.intro: Chocobanana started in my little Montréal home, surrounded by paper, stickers, half-finished ideas and my cat Winnie who usually thinks everything on my desk belongs to her.
about.p1: It became a place for me to turn the things I love, places I discover and little everyday moments into something you can find in your mailbox.
about.p2: Made by me, occasionally approved by Winnie 🍌💌

faq.title: FAQ
faq.intro: A few answers from how the club works today.
faq.q1: Do I need an account to order?
faq.a1: No. You can continue as a guest. An account saves your details and is required for member discounts.
faq.q2: How does the 10% welcome discount work?
faq.a2: Create an account, then sign in before you pay. It applies once, to your first order, and does not combine with another code.
faq.q3: How do the every-5-orders rewards work?
faq.a3: Every 5 completed orders on your account earns one code for 10% off a later order. That code works only on this account.
faq.a4: We ship to Canada, the United States, Australia, France, Germany and Türkiye. Standard postage is included in Snail Mail Club package prices.

shipping.title: Shipping
shipping.intro: How and when your mail travels.
shipping.postage: Snail Mail Club prices include standard postage. Sticker sheets ship free in Canada; CA$1 per sheet is added for the USA and CA$2 per sheet for other countries.
shipping.countries: We ship to Canada, the United States, Australia, France, Germany and Türkiye by standard letter mail, usually without tracking.
shipping.stickers: Sticker sheets are mailed within 5 business days. Club envelopes are mailed during the first 10 days of each month; orders paid by the 20th join that month's mailing.
shipping.timing: Usual delivery after mailing: Canada 2–9 business days, USA 6–12, other countries 10–25. If something hasn't arrived after 30 days (45 outside Canada and the USA) or arrives damaged, write to us and we'll resend or refund.
shipping.duties: Outside Canada, the destination country may charge import taxes or duties on arrival. These are paid by the recipient.
